questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Eastern Storm?
At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 332, against Kei on 2018/11/17.

questions.question: At which ground did Liane Glass record their career-best bowling figures (4-20, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Eastern Storm on 2024/04/05.

questions.question: At Recreation Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
Kirstie Thomson set a database record (12/13 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 58. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Kirstie Thomson.

questions.question: "Lions" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: Both Central Gauteng and Gauteng were folded into the Lions.
